@RepGrothman Good afternoon Congressman Grothman! I had notice today you voted to impeach President Trump. Would you care to comment on why you chose to do that?

House Republicans passing the FY26 MilConVA bill is a step toward real accountability—$152 billion with a $5B boost over last year, yet still drowning in bureaucratic bloat. Fully funding veterans' care? Non-negotiable. But let’s dissect the "politicized initiatives" line: banning VA funds for DEI programs and gender-affirming care while blocking medical claims for illegal aliens isn’t fiscal responsibility—it’s culture war theater.

The bill’s $300M for mental health and homelessness assistance is critical, but why pair it with arbitrary restrictions that distract from core mission support? Military construction gets a nod, but until we audit every dollar spent on overpriced contractors and redundant base projects, "strengthening national security" remains a talking point.

Prioritize vets, yes—but don’t pretend this cleans up systemic waste.
